news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹29.32 (vs ₹18.33 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹29.32 (up from ₹18.33 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.78b (up 23% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹252.4m (up 60% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 14% (up from 11% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 32% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 9% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
